owner: commander - the ledger is the ruling surface, the ruler only obeys it
why_this_file_exists: The Q64 no-growth arm used to be released by a hand at the gate: --exposure-arm off, a re-pinned ruler blob, or a hand-landed candidate. An exemption is now DATA that the ruler reads and applies, so a cell is either covered by a named entry or it is not, and the answer travels inside the measurement document instead of in a chat message. Deciding WHICH entries are active stays the commander's call; this file is where that call is written down.

policy.match_root: paths are relative to the --tree root the door hands the ruler (frontend/src), e.g. stories/V10Primitives.stories.tsx
policy.globs: in a path_glob, ** spans any number of segments, * stays inside one segment, and a dot matches itself
policy.blanket_grant: an entry with a wildcard path_glob AND rule '*' is REFUSED: the ruler marks the whole run NOT_PERFORMED so the door cannot read a zeroed census as a clean tree
policy.active_requires: status active requires a non-empty decided_by naming the ruling; a violation rejects the WHOLE ledger (fail-closed, never a partial apply)
policy.held_is_inert: a held entry never exempts anything; it is reported with held_would_match so the commander can see the size of a waiver before signing it
policy.not_a_face: There is no entry shape in this ledger that can waive a cell the traveler can actually see. Product-surface waivers are a ruling question (Q64/Q67/Q70/Q71), not a data edit.
